peoples_entry.name: Tabisti (Ibisen & Reed Lake)
peoples_entry.note: The Ibisen (Tabisti, speaking Amazigh-template Tabist) of the hyperbaric East Abyss salt-deltas (Tabist, Liikofi, Mungo, Lower Verge) and their Reed Lake & sub-rim cataract-terrace kinsfolk (LORE.md §6.9–6.10, tongues-of-krator.html): Maghrebi Atlas burnous/selham/tagelmust cloaks, triangular silver tizerzai fibulae, curved koummya daggers, Tifinagh-like Yaz (ⵣ) salt-marks, and sacred glinting tin-mirror cladding fused seamlessly with Andean warp-faced uncu tunics, ear-flap chullo caps, braided warak'a brow-slings, awayo/q'epi cliff-packs, vulcanized rubber ojota sandals, and the stepped salt-white Temple of the Altar (tools/garments/cultures/tabisti.py).
